subject: Supplier onboarding — BCP verification needed for SOC2/CAIQ intake
body:
From: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcel Hall <marc.hall@acme-supply.com>, OnyxCloud Security <security@onyxcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding — BCP verification needed for SOC2/CAIQ intake

Hi Marcel / Onyx team,

Thanks again for starting the supplier onboarding flow with Redwood. As part of our SOC 2 and CAIQ intake we need a compact BCP/DR evidence package that addresses our RTO/RPO expectations for vendor-hosted services that are in the inference pipeline. Specifically we're looking for:

- High-level recovery model (hot/warm/cold) for the services used to ingest and forward payloads to Redwood.
- RTO and RPO targets observed in the last 12 months for critical components (API ingress, message queue, metadata DB).
- A recent tabletop or restore runbook test summary (date, scope, outcome).
- List of personnel with restore privileges and succession (on-call rotation).
- Network diagram highlighting egress paths, peering, and failover regions.

I've attached a lightweight index (Redwood_BCP_Evidence_Index.xlsx) with the sections we typically use for audits. If you can populate the index and attach any supporting artifacts (runbook excerpt, test logs, screenshots), that will help our compliance reviewer triage quickly.

Ask: Can you share the initial evidence and confirm a 30–45 minute call this week to walk through the items? Our compliance window for this intake is Nov 4.

Thanks,

Kim Park
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Redwood_BCP_Evidence_Index.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---
On Tue, Oct 27, 2026 at 09:02 AM, Marcel Hall <marc.hall@acme-supply.com> wrote:
From: Marcel Hall <marc.hall@acme-supply.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — BCP verification needed for SOC2/CAIQ intake

Hi Kim,

Appreciate the checklist — we'll get you an initial drop by EOD tomorrow. Quick clarifications:

1) For RTO/RPO: do you want point-in-time DR proofs (e.g., restore timestamps) or our stated SLAs + most recent test artifacts? We can provide both but want to prioritize.
2) For network diagram: we'll provide a redacted public-facing diagram; full peering details are sensitive — will that be sufficient for your compliance team?

We run a warm-standby for the API tier (RTO target 30 minutes, RPO ~5 minutes for messaging) and cold restore for our analytics DB (RTO 8 hours). I can pull the last runbook test we executed on 2026-09-16 — it includes timings and operator play-by-play.

Marcel
Director, Platform Ops — Acme Supply Co.

On Tue, Oct 27, 2026 at 10:10 AM, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcel Hall <marc.hall@acme-supply.com>, OnyxCloud Security <security@onyxcloud.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — BCP verification needed for SOC2/CAIQ intake

Marcel — that's great context, thanks. A couple quick operational asks from our side:

- If you can prioritize the API ingress warm-standby proof and the 2026-09-16 test log that will unblock our intake. The analytics DB cold-restore artifacts can come later in the package.
- For network diagram redaction: a high-level diagram that shows regions, failover targets, and third-party peering is acceptable; we do not need IPs.
- Can you also include the ops playbook excerpts that demonstrate the automated vs manual steps during failover (search for 'automatic restore' and 'manual intervention' sections).

I'll schedule a quick 30-minute sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT — sending calendar invite now.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: mtr-ops-runbook.pdf (runbook excerpt)

From: OnyxCloud Security <security@onyxcloud.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcel Hall <marc.hall@acme-supply.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — BCP verification needed for SOC2/CAIQ intake

Hi Kim / Ben,

Thanks for the checklist and calls. Please find the initial artifacts attached:

- Onyx_SIG_response.pdf — completed SIG-lite responses focusing on BC-DR controls.
- onyx_network_map.png — redacted topology showing regions and failover targets.
- test-summary-20260916.txt (in body) — short summary log from the 2026-09-16 tabletop showing RTO/RPO timings for the API tier.

Quick highlights:
- API ingress: warm stand-by in two regions; measured RTO ~28–35 minutes across simulated failovers; RPO observed <= 6 minutes for messaging when using persistent queueing.
- Message queue: high-availability cluster with cross-region replication; failover mechanism is automated with operator approval window.
- Analytics DB: cold restore from snapshots — typical restore time 6–9 hours depending on snapshot size.

We're still redacting some personnel identifiers for the public pack but can provide a signed attestation of the on-call rotation and key-holder list under an NDA if required.

Let us know if you want raw logs and I can share a secure link.

Regards,
OnyxCloud Security Team
---
Attachment: Onyx_SIG_response.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: onyx_network_map.png (image)

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. This is exactly the level of detail we needed for the initial SOC 2 intake. Next steps:

1) Ben and I will review the SIG PDF and the network map today and flag any follow-ups specific to RTO measurement methodology.
2) Marcel — if you can drop the 2026-09-16 test logs into the Drive folder I linked, that will complete the intake. If there are any constraints on personnel lists, we'll accept an attestation under NDA as suggested.
3) We'll keep the calendar invite for tomorrow but can shorten to 20 minutes if the artifacts are complete.

Appreciate the coordination.

Kim
Security Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
